# War Scroll Column 18 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 18 | **Condition:** heavily damaged

---

**1** [...Blessed be] the God of Israel, who keeps covenant faithfulness with His covenant [...] and the appointed times of

**2** salvation with the people of His redemption. He has called those who stumble to wondrous mighty deeds, and He has gathered the assembly of

**3** the nations for destruction without remnant [...] the gates of salvation He has opened many times [...] the covenant of peace [...]

**4** [...] and the star of [...] and [...] Jacob [...] Your splendor shall [...]

**5** [...] Your mighty ones [...] in the gates [...] many times [...]

**6** [...] and Belial [...] and all the spirits of his lot [...] they shall fall in [...]

**7** [...] great destruction [...] for they shall not stand [...] in the battle [...]

**8** [...] from of old You have appointed the time of [...] the mysteries of [...]

**9** [...] to make known [...] our enemies have fallen [...] the power [...]

**10** [...] the mighty warriors of [...] Your great hand [...] the enemies of Your people [...]

**11** [...] and the hand of [...] the slain [...] and the warriors [...]

**12** [...] and upon the earth [...] the peoples [...] and the mighty ones [...]

**13** [...] to give thanks for [...] the great deeds of God [...] His steadfast love [...]

**14** [...] for our God [...] the congregation of [...] forever [...]

**15** [...] and truth [...] eternity [...]

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 18 preserves fragments of the victory hymn sung after God's decisive intervention in col. 17. Heavy damage throughout — only lines 1-3 have substantial text. "Steadfast love" renders chesed in the hymnic context (18:13), contrasting with "covenant faithfulness" in 18:1 where the covenant context is explicit. Line divisions follow Yadin.*
